description: Calculate a court deadline from cited rules (weekends, court holidays, service extensions and local rules applied). Returns the date, each counting step, the verbatim rule text and source for every rule used, any safe-date disclosure and any fixed statutory dates. Ask the user for the trigger date and how the paper was served; do not assume them. Show the user the citation and source link with every date or rule. Results are not legal advice. Coverage: Deadlines: California in depth (civil, family, probate, eviction, small claims, government claims, criminal, juvenile, appeals, agencies, pre-suit clocks, special proceedings, statutes of limitations; local rules for all 58 counties), federal civil and criminal, federal bankruptcy, and a partial Texas set. Other states’ deadlines are not covered. Court directory: every U.S. county.

county.description: California county slug, to use that superior court's local rules and closures

court.description: Court id for local rules: cacd, cand, casd, caed, ca9, cacb, canb, casb, caeb, or 1dca to 6dca (CA-APP)

deadline_type.description: Rule id from search_rules or list_deadline_rules, e.g. "noticed_motion_opposition"

service_method.description: How the triggering paper was served, e.g. "mail" (TX), "mail_in_state", "electronic", "substituted" (CA). Omit for personal service.

state.description: Rule set id: TX, CA, CA-FAM, CA-APP, US, US-BK, US-CRIM, CA-PROB, CA-UD, CA-SC, CA-GOV, CA-CRIM, CA-JUV, CA-AGENCY, CA-PRESUIT, CA-SPECIAL, CA-SOL

trigger_date.description: Trigger date as YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. date of service or date judgment signed)

name: calculate_deadline
